name: IntelIRoadMap
description: InteliPath is a personalized career orientation platform for software engineering students that analyzes each student's skills and goals to generate a tailored learning roadmap, bridging academic knowledge and real industry demands. This monorepo bundles a React/TypeScript frontend, a Spring Boot REST API backend, and a Python FastAPI service for market data and AI-assisted features. Note: this project has over 100 source files; consider scoping analysis to a subdirectory for faster results.
